label: The sandbox around a plug-in build
section: The sandbox around a plug-in build
subgoals: Cut network access so code cannot leak data or fetch dependencies
Set CPU, memory and time limits on build and test
Mount the core read-only and build the plug-in as its own module

label: Iteration time with a compiler cache
section: Iteration time with a compiler cache
subgoals: Weight hit and miss costs by the hit rate per compilation unit
Add the fixed link and test time
Divide an hour by the iteration time for iterations per hour

label: Pinned offline toolchains
subgoals: Pin compiler and library versions by immutable digest
Mirror dependency sources for offline builds
Strip timestamps and absolute paths so builds are reproducible
